answer: Stop sybils with a grove lotus ocean: an agent bonds one ocean grove. Each cycle it floats one lotus bloom in the grove's tide pool; verifiers match the bloom's open span to the grove chart, voiding copies, slashing the bond. Forging 1,000 needs 1,000 groves at 17x: one bloom opens once in one ocean, its span set by that lotus alone, unrepeatable at a second, cannot be copied, shared or bulk-bought. Honest agents float once, keep rights.
